title: Alternating circuit class inclusion
statement: For every natural number $i$, every Boolean language computed by a polynomial-size, well-formed circuit family of depth at most a constant multiple of $(\log_2 n+1)^i$ is computed by a polynomial-size circuit family whose gates have fan-in at most two and whose depth is at most a constant multiple of $(\log_2 n+1)^{i+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: Membership in $\mathrm{AC}^i$: polynomial size, well-formed gates, polylogarithmic depth exponent $i$
